notes.title: Trading Cards Released!
notes.notes:
To celebrate the one month anniversary of Swipecart's release, trading cards have been released! The set features 5 cards and has plenty of cute icons and emoticons to go with. I'm very proud of how far the game has come and this is a reward for those who have shared the experience with me. 

Thanks again for playing and remember, please cart responsibly!

notes.title: Trading Cards coming soon! Workshop (hopefully) as well.
notes.notes:
I'm super pleased with the amount of people having fun with the game, and I want to reward those who put in their time and dedication with cards and the other goodies that go with them. They will be launched in time for the upcoming Summer Sale which is a perfect oportunity to win over some new fans and entice retired drivers to complete just a few more tracks.

Workshop support is still up in the air as I look into how to implement it, but if possible would be within the next few months.

If you don't have a gamepad and aren't comfortable playing the game with mouse controls, I would again like to showcase the other versions of the game, available for just about any phone or tablet on the market. The touch controls work like the mouse and provide an authentic experience.

[url=https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/swipecart/id862967048?ls=1&mt=8]iOS version[/url]

[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.microfactory.swipecart]Android version[/url]

As always, please cart responsibly.
